description: This file defines a TableCell interface class for accessibility features, providing properties and methods to access table cell attributes such as span, headers, position, and related table.

classes.name: TableCell
classes.description: An interface used by cells in a table, providing properties and methods to access cell attributes such as span, headers, position, and associated table.

methods.name: get_columnSpan
methods.description: Returns the number of columns occupied by this cell.

methods.name: get_columnHeaderCells
methods.description: Returns the column headers as an array of cell accessibles.

methods.name: get_rowSpan
methods.description: Returns the number of rows occupied by this cell.

methods.name: get_rowHeaderCells
methods.description: Returns the row headers as an array of cell accessibles.

methods.name: get_position
methods.description: Returns the tabular position of this accessible.

methods.name: getRowColumnSpan
methods.description: Determines the row and column indices and span of the given cell.

methods.name: get_table
methods.description: Returns a reference to the accessible of the containing table.
